simple.meaning: צֹעַר (Tsôʻar) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Genesis 13:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, city, land, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צֹעַר (H6820) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows צֹעַר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: צֹעַר (Tsôʻar) / H6820 is tracked through Genesis 13:10, Genesis 14:2, Genesis 14:8, Genesis 19:22. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
